physics: native MuJoCo 3.3.0, free M1/Piper H/official gripper/passive hinge
reference_source: P6 stationary waypoints, grasp geometry and support/contact safety thresholds from config/p6_{pull,push}.yaml; no frozen trajectory or reference clock in the independent judge.
timing: Event counters accrue only on consecutive valid physical steps. Reach is TCP-handle <=5 mm for 60 ms, replacing the reference-timed pregrasp/approach events. Opening requires the requested angle and bilateral contact for 150 ms. Hold requires 500 ms stable, gripped, |hinge speed| <0.01 rad/s. Final parking includes a stowed arm and 3 s at target with released gripper. Other numerical thresholds/timeouts follow P6 or the registered sum of its pregrasp and approach timeouts.

comparison.common_initialization: one supervised checkpoint after 12000 steps x 256, seed 701, lr 0.0005; 4000/8000 for recovery and development evidence, fixed final checkpoint
comparison.branches: 512 further Actor updates each, batch 256, identical BC sampling seed 1701, lr 0.0001; WM compute and frozen-encoder calibration separately recorded
comparison.collection_feedback: 4 common-parent training-condition episodes (two sides x two commands, tr_nominal); unsupervised for BC and eligible as train-only replay for WM
comparison.success_video: first passing student case, saved exact qpos/physics timestamps from its scored rollout, 1280x720 or higher, 25 fps original time

budget_scope: new MM01 run; no historical B0 update allowance carried over
